methods.label: Evaluate the derivative at the point
methods.explanation:
The tangent slope equals the derivative at that point. At \(x=-1\),
\[
f'(-1)=2(-1)=-2.
\]
Thus the tangent line falls from left to right, with slope \(-2\).
methods.levelReason: Interpreting a derivative as a tangent slope and evaluating the supplied derivative fit the stated elective unit. No differentiation rule is needed.
